text:
ellie-cs: Hey team — customer ACME Corp is seeing 403 on both embeddings and text-gen after rotating keys. UI shows "insufficient permissions". I have a repro key from them.

derek-platform: Thanks. Can you paste the decoded JWT claims? That usually shows scopes.

ellie-cs: Pasting sanitized token claims:
```json
{
  "sub": "svc_acme_123",
  "scopes": "embeddings",
  "iss": "redwood-sso",
  "exp": 1712340000
}
```
They only have embeddings scope. No inference/rerank.

sam-engr: That explains it — embed-only keys will 403 on generation/rerank. Did they expect a broad key? Any automation that rotated to reduced-scope key?

ellie-cs: They use a provisioning script from their IDP; they claim it "mirrors" previous token. Possibly the automation strips scopes on rotation. Customer is blocked on production batch job.

morgan-ops: Can we confirm server logs? @auth-checker-bot run-check svc_acme_123

auth-checker-bot: bot: Found token svc_acme_123 — scopes: embeddings — last used 4112345600 — no inference or rerank entitlements.

derek-platform: Quick mitigation: create a temporary service key with inference+embeddings+rerank scopes and give them a short-lived token. I can do tenant-level quick grant if legal ok.

ellie-cs: Customer approved temporary key for 24h. I created temp key id svc_acme_tmp and granted scopes: inference, embeddings, rerank. They confirm generator calls succeed now.

sam-engr: Root cause: our provisioner semicolon delimiter parser drops multi-scope entries if quoting mismatched. We saw similar but slightly different in other tickets. I'll open an internal issue.

sam-engr: Action items:
- eng: add unit test for provisioning CSV delimiter edgecases (sam-engr)
- platform: add validation on key creation to warn if requested scopes will truncate (derek-platform)
- cs: rotate customer back once fix deployed (ellie-cs)

ellie-cs: Noted. Logging ticket with repro and sample CSV/terraform snippet customer used. attaching snippet.

ellie-cs: customer snippet:
```yaml
service_account:
  id: svc_acme_123
  scopes: "embeddings; inference; rerank"
```
It seems the semicolon + space caused the prov script to take only first token.

derek-platform: Thanks. I'll wedge a quick guard in the provisioner to normalize delimiters and trim quotes. Will ack here when deployed.

morgan-ops: FYI flagged for possible audit since production token lost inference perms unexpectedly.

ellie-cs: Customer happy with temp key, will wait for the fix. Marking as escalated -> in progress. :thumbsup:
